name: check-work
description: Verification node any workflow can end with: reconstruct completion claims from the supplied text, derive 2-4 executable checks, run them against the work root, and fail the run when a claimed artifact is not actually there — the engine-native half of the check-work skill, calling the same derivation core.

claims.help: The text carrying the completion claims to verify — a stage's findings, a session summary, or the message that said the work was done. Checks are derived from what THIS text claims, not from the task description.

root.help: Directory the derived checks run against. Blank uses the run's own workspace, which is where an upstream stage's files land.

metadata.why_free: Zero model calls: claim reconstruction and check derivation are deterministic, and every check is a bounded filesystem read confined under the root. Command checks report unverifiable — this node never shells out on its own authority.

steering_examples.description: Verify the claims from the build stage's summary against the run workspace.
Point the root at the repo checkout instead of the run workspace — the files were written there.

example_outputs: a pass/fail/unverifiable verdict per derived check with quoted evidence, and a FAILED run when a claimed file is missing
metadata.when_not_to_use: whole-feature or spec-driven assurance — that is the deep QA companion's half; this is the light, immediate check over what was just claimed
